merging_on: MERGING (on): when several checks follow the same flow (same entry point and navigation path, non-terminal), write ONE test case that interleaves actions and assertions in the order a tester performs them: assert the entry control, click it, assert what appears, interact with the next control, assert its content, assert mandatory markers. Do not merge checks that end in different outcomes (for example Save vs Discard, Download PDF vs Print), need different starting states or roles, change data that invalidates the next check, or mix a happy path with a negative outcome. A merged test case may END with one final action (save, discard, delete, print, download, duplicate, navigate away); two different final actions are always separate test cases. Keep a merged test case to about {{merge_max_steps}} steps; split a longer flow at a natural point such as opening a new screen or panel. Combine all mandatory-field checks of one form into one test case.
merging_off: MERGING (off): do not combine checks. Write one test case per check, even when the flows are identical.
heavy_on: HEAVY (avoid): do NOT write performance, load, stress or response-time test cases, and do not write test cases that need a large data volume (large numbers of records, bulk imports or exports, large files).
heavy_off: HEAVY (allowed): performance and data-volume test cases are allowed when the backlog or the user's notes call for them. Never invent thresholds.
ui_exclude_visual_only: UI POLICY: do NOT test colors, positions, alignment, sizes, fonts, spacing, themes, icon appearance or thumbnails. Checking that a control exists, what it contains and how it behaves is allowed.
ui_exclude_all_ui_elements: UI POLICY: do NOT write assertions about UI elements themselves (existence of buttons or labels, their position, color or size). Test behavior and data outcomes only: results of actions, saved values, validation outcomes, permissions.
ui_include_ui: UI POLICY: tests of UI elements are allowed (existence, labels, enabled or disabled state). Do not assert color, position or pixel layout unless the backlog or the user's notes state them.
tags_on: TAGS: give each test case tags from this vocabulary: {{tag_vocabulary}}. Add "smoke" to every happy_path test case whose priority is "{{priority_high}}"; add "regression" to every test case. Use only vocabulary values.
tags_off: TAGS: always return an empty tags array.
